description: The tabular-data set: a horizontally scrollable container around a semantic <table>. The container takes size (md/sm) and variant (default/plain); TableHead and TableCell can pin to the start or end edge. The DS recipe reads these off data-size / data-variant / data-sticky. The container also takes tone (neutral/accent, data-tone), which colours selected rows: neutral is the muted fill with primary text, accent the opt-in primary wash with accent text. Sorting is controlled and data-agnostic: Table takes sort and onSortChange, and a TableHead with a sortKey renders a button with a direction icon and carries aria-sort while its column is sorted; the caller sorts the rows.

aligns.description: How a head or body cell aligns its content. start is the default; end aligns the content to the inline end with tabular figures, for numbers and money, so digits line up.
